newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps all hold as market splutters at start.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps all hold as market splutters at start.

text.p: European oil swaps were steady on Monday. Dealers said activity was slow.

Brent crude CFDs were quiet with nothing heard traded. June 2-6 week was pegged unchanged around -31/32 cents below July Brent with June 9-13 hovering very narrowly stronger at -29/30 compared with -31 cents on Friday.
Gas oil crack spreads were pegged around $4.15 for 3Q, $4.80 for 4Q and $4.70 for 1Q98.
Heavy fuel was a touch stronger by 50 cents or so with June bid at $83 and offered at $83.75. Swaps were slow and nothing was seen on physical barges which were at $82-83.
Low sulphur swaps were ranged around June $93 with good physical supply weighing in.
Gasoline held steady with June at $207 value and July still showing a $6 backwardation.
Naphtha swap levels were also unchanged in June although the spread against July widened a touch.
Traders said July was valued around $189, up $1 or so, sustaining some support from consolidating Brent crude.
